The person behind Dorset Division

Experience matters. So does knowing what to do with it.

I'm Marnie Danson, and Dorset Division is the business I've built around more than 20 years of working across different industries, roles and commercial challenges.

I've managed ecommerce catalogues with more than 5,000 products, built websites and digital systems, developed brands, worked across major selling platforms, supported publishing projects and helped businesses make sense of problems that don't come with straightforward answers.

That experience has taught me something important: a good idea is only useful if it can work in the real world.

I don't separate the strategy from the practicalities. I want to know what something will cost, how it will operate, what could go wrong and what it will take to make it successful.

And because Dorset Division is independent, there's no account manager between us. When you hire me, I'm the person doing the work.

Dorset Division | SNUG

Professional reference

I'm Chris, founder and Managing Director of SNUG (snugcompany.shop). I founded SNUG to address an often overlooked area of men's personal wellbeing, confidence and intimate health, and I have worked directly with Marnie at Dorset Division on its development.

As our work developed, I offered Marnie the position of Head of Strategy & Product Development for SNUG. I did this because of the breadth of her involvement and the value she brings to the business.

Marnie worked closely with me to establish SNUG's brand positioning, develop our tone of voice and messaging, and communicate the personal story and purpose behind the brand. That story is my own, and she handled it with real care.

Through detailed founder discovery sessions, research and discussion with me, she translated my experiences, ideas and ambitions into a clear brand direction. She kept our customers' needs, confidence and privacy at the centre of the approach throughout.

Marnie also led substantial research and functional planning for our Fit Finder. She reviewed manufacturers' sizing guidance, developed the customer journey and documented how the recommendation process should work.

What stands out to me is her ability to see the bigger picture while also doing the detailed work needed to move a project forward. She brings commercial awareness, creativity, structured research and practical problem-solving.

Working with her has been open and constructive. She listens, challenges my ideas where appropriate and works towards solutions that make sense for both the business and its customers.

I would happily recommend Marnie and Dorset Division to any business looking for someone who can contribute at a strategic level while also taking an active role in brand development, product planning and delivery. I'm glad to be contacted directly to discuss her work.

Chris
Founder & Managing Director, SNUG
snugcompany.shop

How we work together

From figuring it out to getting it finished.

Bring your idea, your brief or the challenge you're facing. We'll work out what matters and where to begin.

Some projects start with a specific task. Others start with a conversation about what's not working.

My job is to understand the situation, work out the sensible way forward and then put that into practice.

See my approach ↗
01

Tell me what's happening

Tell me what you're trying to achieve, what's getting in the way or what you need someone to take care of. We start with the real situation, not a sales pitch.

02

Work out what makes sense

I'll look at the requirements, investigate where necessary and recommend a practical approach. You'll know what's involved, what it costs and what we're agreeing to do.

03

Put the work into motion

Research, strategy, website development, ecommerce, branding, content, marketing or publishing — whatever the agreed project requires, I get on with delivering it.

04

Finish it properly

The work is reviewed, finalised and handed over clearly. If there are further steps, you'll know what they are and why they matter.

Let's talk business

You know where you want to go. Let's work out how to get there.

Whether you're starting something new, developing an existing business or tackling a challenge, I'd love to hear about it.

We'll start with a straightforward conversation about your business, your goals and how I can help.
